pages.text: A Gem Socket is a bauble that can be worn in the Body slot.$(br2)Activating a Gem Socket allows you to slot in an Arcane Gem. You always treat this gem as if you were holding it for the purposes of passive effects.$(br2)The following Arcane Gems have passive effects. Gems with toggles might need to be turned on before inserting before their passive effects take place.
Gem Sockets can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
